data.observation_model: Each assay yields an independent binary pass indicator with the same fixed unknown probability p; assays in both stages obey this same Bernoulli model. These independence and stationarity assumptions are stipulated for a controlled design calculation, not established from observations. The null is p<=the supplied upper bound; the planning alternative is the supplied fixed p.
data.stopping_rule: For each candidate, observe all first-stage assays. Reject the null immediately and stop if first-stage successes are at least first_look_success_threshold. Otherwise run all second-stage assays and reject iff total successes across both stages are at least final_total_success_threshold. There is no early futility stop, no other interim analysis and no later restart. A first threshold greater than the first-stage sample size simply prevents early rejection. An unobserved second-stage count may be represented by an independent hypothetical continuation count when calculating rejection probabilities, but those assays are NOT charged after early stopping.
data.selection_policy: A candidate is admissible iff its maximum rejection probability over the entire null is at most maximum_type_I_error and its rejection probability at the planning alternative is at least minimum_planning_power. Among admissible listed candidates minimize expected number of actually performed assays under the planning alternative; ties within1e-12 absolute prefer lexical plan_id. Compute the actual stopping-rule rejection event, retaining dependence between the first count and the final cumulative count. Fixed-n final tails alone and adding the two marginal look probabilities are not the sequential error rate.
data.reporting: Report every candidate maximum null rejection probability,admissible_plan_ids,the selected_plan_id,the selected planning power and selected expected actual assay count. All probabilities are fractions; expected count is a real expectation,not a rounded integer. Numeric accuracy1e-8 absolute plus1e-7 relative; IDs exact. Optional limitation prose is unscored.

provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled sequential process qualification design; no assay observations,real certification or empirical accuracy claim.
provenance.method_context: Exact finite Bernoulli path probabilities and a prespecified two-look stopping policy. The binomial primitive does not automatically correct optional stopping.
